task_copy.method: harness wrappers of every enqueue/_destination decision, not CUDA profiling

memory_ledger.interpretation: CUDA free excludes all resident memory; subtract charged resident framework bytes once from ceiling. Task images/bank/auxiliary remain outstanding. Pool retention is included in CUDA used, never credited as free.
